name: Teen Night Planning Committee
what_you_do: Plan and run free, large Teen Night events at the museum. You pick activities, book young artists and performers, and promote the events on social media.
who_can_apply: All New York City high school students.
pay_detail: $17 per hour. Second-year members are leaders and earn $18 per hour. Up to 75 hours for the year. OMNY cards for weekend and evening work.
duration: November 2026 to May 2027: Wednesdays 4:30 to 6:30 PM, plus some Fridays and weekends.
deadline_text: The 2026 to 2027 deadline has passed. The page says to come back in June 2027 to apply for the fall 2027 program.
how_to_apply: Online application through the link on the program page when it is open.
notes: You must commit to the full schedule. Questions: teen.programs@brooklynmuseum.org.
